items.title: What ISO 14001:2026 means for the future of environmental management
items.summary: edie’s latest webinar, sponsored by BSI, explored the newly revised ISO 14001:2026 standard and what its changes mean for sustainability professionals.

items.title: More than half of European industrial leaders expect water risks to constrain growth by 2031
items.summary: New research has found that more than half of European industrial leaders expect water availability or quality to become a serious barrier to their organisation’s growth within the next five years.

items.title: Boardroom Briefing: Building the business case for social value
items.summary: edie's Boardroom Briefing series provides senior business leaders with authoritative analysis of key sustainability issues and the material impacts that inaction will have on the bottom line.

items.title: Report: Global warming forecast to reach 2.3C as net-zero slips to 2090s
items.summary: A new report has revealed that the world is on track to reach net-zero emissions in 2098, with the forecast pointing to 2.3C of global warming by the end of the century.

items.title: Ireland announces €1.28bn boost for climate and energy
items.summary: The Irish Government has allocated €1.28bn in its 2027 Budget to help accelerate climate action, protect the environment and tackle fuel poverty.
